slot_note: Numbered from seed RC08 (a wind turbine's five faults and its one spring crew visit); the seed's world collides with shipped task187 and its client domain reaches Root-Cause only through interpretability, so architecture 1 moved to an NHS Talking Therapies service and died at stage 4 (lineage). Architecture 2 moves domain, world, dataset and shell: a regional bowel cancer screening programme's equity fund, keeping the decision kind (one of five changes gets the single fix) and the quantity's kind (what that change cost over the year, in the period's natural unit).
niche: a regional bowel cancer screening programme's 2026-27 equity fund: which of five changes on its review costs the most deprived fifth the most completed screens in 2025-26, when the integrated care board's shared registration service, in force since April 2024, applied address changes months after they were asked for, so a kit despatched while a change was pending went to the address the person had left, a loss running at the same rate in both years that a comparison of 2025-26 against 2024-25 never sees
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field and the fund's terms correctly age-standardises completion by deprivation fifth, costs each change on the review against 2024-25 (the localities for the outreach, the half-years for the reminder, the residual for the April changes) and files the reminder moved to eight weeks for the most deprived fifth's lost screens, setting the shared registration service aside because it ran through both years; its loss is a level, not a movement: kits despatched while the person's address change was still pending went to the address they had left, at the same rate in both years.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each change's cost in completed screens to the most deprived fifth, the equity decomposition of that fifth's shortfall by cause, worked on the screening pathway's own grain (an invitation, a posted kit, a usable result inside thirteen weeks) and standardised for age; a noun swap keeps a mailing but loses the deprivation fifth, the round structure and the completion clock that turn a kit's reach into the deprived fifth's lost screens.
layer1: a registration history whose address rows carry the date a change took effect, beside the shared service's own work queue of requests with received and completed dates
the programme's monthly uptake report computed on the address held at despatch, against the fund's terms reading the same address
kit results returned from the laboratory with spoilt and technical-failure rows that are re-tested under a new kit
an age extension adding first-time invitees mid-round
despatch dates in local time against laboratory receipt stamps in UTC
the review's localities defined on practice lists, against residence for deprivation
stakeholder_role: programme manager for the regional bowel screening hub

spine.entity: one screening invitation with its posted kit

world.org_type: an NHS foundation trust hosting the region's bowel cancer screening hub

driver: The decisive quantity is what a change in force through both compared years costs every year through a cohort no column marks, members whose change of record was still pending when their summons was sent and who were summoned at a place they had left; a comparison of the year against the last gives it nothing, because its loss is a level and not a movement, while the changes dated between the years take the year-on-year fall.
driver_concrete: Each 2025-26 kit set against the shared registration service's own work queue: where an address change had been asked for before the kit was despatched and was applied after it, the kit went to the address the person had left and almost never came back completed; that loss runs at the same rate in 2024-25 and 2025-26, so costing each change against 2024-25 gives the shared service nothing while the reminder change takes the fall.
stump: A solver who age-standardises completion by deprivation fifth and costs each change against 2024-25 files the reminder moved to eight weeks for the most deprived fifth's lost screens and sets the shared registration service aside as in force through both years; the step that lands them there is never setting each kit's despatch date against the person's pending address change, which shows the most deprived fifth losing more screens to kits sent to the address the person had left than to any change on the review, so the fund goes to the shared registration service.

differentiation.task303: task303 sizes what an intervention on one unit removes from its recorded losses when part of that record is a shared loss every unit fed from one source carries; here the decisive relation is whether each posted kit reached the person, read by setting its despatch date against the shared service's pending address change, and the call names the change whose loss is a level that a year-on-year comparison cannot see.
differentiation.task258: task258 counts how many units an intervention moves across a threshold when its effect works through a reference each unit's own document must carry, and the back-test passes by construction; here nothing crosses a threshold: each kit's reach is read from its despatch date against a pending change in another service's queue, and the decisive point is that the loss runs at one rate through both compared years.

lineage.architecture: v1 (Psychology and Behavioural Science: a charity-run NHS Talking Therapies service's 2025-26 fall in recoveries, agency high-intensity cover on 12-week blocks breaking step 3 courses, read as the waiting list's)

world.geography: England, a fictional county integrated care board area
world.org_type: a mental health charity delivering the county's NHS Talking Therapies service under contract to the integrated care board (stepped care, steps 2 and 3)

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of a long wait's apparent harm that runs through the actor the waiting cases were given to, whose fixed-term assignment lapsed mid-case so the case was handed on and abandoned, against the wait's direct path, read only by setting each case's run of actors against the assignment register; because the arrangement was used on the longest-waiting cases, the loss reads as the wait's.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each step 3 course's run of high-intensity therapists, rebuilt from the care contacts across the record migration, set against the agency booking log's assignment ends: the courses an agency block's lapse broke off lose most of their patients after the reallocation, the wait's direct path is about zero among courses whose therapist stayed, and because agency cover took the backlog the loss reads as the waiting list's.
lineage.stump: A solver who walks the fall down the referral-to-recovery funnel finds it in step 3 courses ending early, sees early endings rise with the wait while agency therapists' recovery rates match employed ones, and files C, the waiting list; the step that lands it there is never splitting the wait's effect by setting each course's run of therapists against the agency booking log, which puts the loss on the courses a lapsing agency block broke off and the call on A.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-03 at stage 4: judge SEND_BACK, Gate H rule_application (the filed per-change cost, executed with any-contact exposure, lands A at 250), ask 4 conventions unfiled. Measured: the plan filed each change's cost as expected minus actual recoveries read from the year's other referrals at the same step, largest wins; any-contact exposure gives A 249, the naive comparator 267, the golden 257 (all 250 to the nearest 50), last-clinician exposure 222; change C had no filed in-place date or wait threshold and tied A at 248 to 257 on the same patients; ask 4's monthly agency hours needed unfiled conventions (a dropped old booking, the later of two portal timesheets before 1 August and summing after, catch-up lumps spread over unclaimed weeks, working-day allocation, week-commencing moving June by about 1,200 hours); Gate F low to moderate.

notes: Strategy population_selection: the deprived fifth's shortfall sits on a cohort built from two histories (the invitation's despatch date and the shared service's request and completion dates), never a status word or column. Gate G decomposition_attribution: a correctly counted shortfall assigned to the right change; the repeat WARN is answered by the strategy differing from the window's (binding_constraint, causal_design, decomposition_attribution). Decisive generator G8 (reachability against magnitude): every rival is costed on the size of its change between the years, the decisive step on whether each kit reached the person. G13 (horizon mismatch) carries the year-on-year comparison against a change in force since April 2024.
